notes.title: Patch Notes for 9/17/2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] [b]Removed[/b] Falling off of the raft due to high waves was annoying, so I removed this mechanic all together.
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b] Fireplace hitbox no longer makes it hard to place cooking structures over it. 
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b] Wheelbarrow save location no longer makes it hover when loading back in.
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b] Resources should no longer get stuck in flight to resource piles. This would cause resources to become non-interactable which was incredibly confusing and annoying.
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b] Automatic doors fixed to no longer get stuck not opening.
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b] Filling in dug holes now has additional protection to not close in the player which would cause the player to fall through the ground. 
[*] [b]Bugfix[/b] Fixed Portuguese translation for "Fill Hole".
[/list]

notes.title: Dangerous Waters
notes.notes:
[h2]More Dangers....
[/h2][list][*][p]Fields of Jellyfish now have a chance to drift into your region as you are exploring the waters. Jellyfish have a potent sting that will reduce your hydration by 75% over 3 minutes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504978/39cfdb038288d1810205a28c64d93061ecf8af29.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Eels now inhabit coral reefs. Be on the lookout while harvesting coral so that you don't get poisoned by one. If so, you will become 75% more exhausted over 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]A nasty squid also pops up surprisingly that if you aren't careful can ink you. This comes increases your hunger by 75% over 3 minutes.[/p][/*][*][p]Sharks now lurk near shipwrecks. Keep an eye on them while you look for chests or you run the risk of being bitten. Shark bites will reduce all survival stats by 75% over 3 minutes. [/p][/*][/list][h2]
First Aid...[/h2][list][*][p]The First Aid Station will allow you to address any negative effects received from the newly added animals.[/p][/*][*][p]Treat stings with coconut oils, cure poisons with coral medicine, wash ink using water, and wrap bites with cloth bandages. [/p][/*][*][p]First Aid Station requires 2 Driftwood, 2 Cloth, and 1 Book to build.[/p][/*][*][p]Since books were previously only a rare collectible item, luggage suitcases now have a 20% chance to also drop a book.[/p][/*][/list][h2]
Balancing Changes...[/h2][list][*][p]Thirst, hunger, and exhaustion stats are now depleted 50% slower. This should make it easier to obtain more positive grades. Please report back if it seems to easy now.[/p][/*][*][p]Chests from shipwrecks now have a 65% chance of dropping scrap metal. This was increased from before to enable more advanced buildings to be obtained more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]Scrapping wooden barrels now requires an axe instead of a pickaxe. Scrapping metal barrels still requires a pickaxe.[/p][/*][*][p]Scrapped wooden barrels now provide 2 driftwood while scrapped metal barrels now provide 2 scrap metal.[/p][/*][*][p]Since I've been adding more and more buildings that require driftwood or boards, you can now split wood logs obtained from cutting down trees to make driftwood. Each wood log will provide 2 driftwood. [/p][/*][*][p]I also added a wood storage building that holds all types of wood. Wood, driftwood, and boards can be stored and used from the wood storage building. [/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2]Message from the dev...[/h2][p]I look forward to hearing everyone's feedback for these changes and let me know what else you'd like to see before I make the official 1.0 release, which will happen before the end of the year. While there is always the potential to add additional features after that, I expect that most of the updates will focus on any bugfixes that need to be addressed,  accessibility/localization adjustments, or small decor additions. Thank you all for the support and kind words I've received over the past 7 months. It has been such a positive experience for me on my first game and I've learned a lot about what it means to publish a game.[/p]

notes.title: Feedback Update and More
notes.notes:
[h3]Localization Updates[/h3][list][*][p]Russian localizations have been updated by [b]Emer, [/b]a member of our community who graciously volunteered to correct my first draft of Russian translations. If you play 'U.N.P.O.C.' using Russian translations, please join me in thanking Emer! Amazing job![/p][/*][*][p]This is our second volunteer to help UNPOC to be more accessible in other languages. While I have given it a first pass, the translations are often incorrect. Please contact me on Steam or Discord if you would like to contribute translations for a language that you would enjoy playing UNPOC in.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p]Free Look Camera Control - A popular request to be able to adjust the angle of the camera. While I like the camera management system in UNPOC, I agree that sometimes it is nice to be able to tilt the camera around to explore underwater or to look out toward the horizon. Now, while holding right click, you can pan and tilt the camera around to get a better view of your surroundings. Let me know what you all thing![/p][/*][*][p]Zoom in further - You can also zoom in a little bit closer to the character.[/p][/*][*][p]GPS Buoys -  Sometimes it is difficult to find out where you are in the world especially when there are lots of islands. GPS Buoys now exists far off shore of every spawned in island. These buoys can be interacted with to show you where you are on the map using there GPS sensors on-board. [/p][/*][*][p]Added a tip to help new players get started down the right path - I've noticed sometimes, it isn't obvious to players what they should even be doing once landing on an island for the first time. I've added some guidance in a tip.[/p][/*][*][p]Added outlining to help text that shows up on the screen - It was hard to read before in sunny conditions. Much better now.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A stone sundial - You must orient the placement correctly for this to provide any real use.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes / Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Can now carry 2 crabs at a time. [/p][/*][*][p]Fish Trophies now always orient correctly when placed.
NOTE: Currently cannot place fish trophies while inside. I'm still working on fixing this.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed raft side barrel interaction distance. Previously the side barrels had way to big of an interaction distance which caused other tools placed on the raft hard to use after reloading a save file.[/p][/*][*][p]Ensured "Sorry Captain" Dialog only ever plays once.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/13/2025
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Items falling through the ground - Now using Unreal Engine's substepping physics setting to allow physics collisions to run separate from the rendering frames. This should reduce the chance that items fall through the ground. I will continue to monitor for feedback regarding this issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Resources overlapping other things that are interactable were difficult to pickup and interact with. The interaction system now uses prioritization system to resolve conflicts instead of just proximity. Resources are highest priority followed by resource piles, then tools and buildings. This should allow you to resolve interaction conflicts more easily. [/p][/*][*][p]Help text errors fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed actions UI spacing issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated fishing basket's "store fish" action to be more consistent with dropping resources for better usability.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a fishing trophy.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the random fire that existed on location \[0, 0, 0] in the world.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504978/8d09be2cc1d19996b180bf1a3b962c831123f657.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Monkeys Update
notes.notes: [h2]Update[/h2][p][/p][h3]Localization Updates[/h3][list][*][p]German localizations have been updated by [b]Sirja, [/b]a member of our community who graciously volunteered to correct my first draft of German translations. If you play 'U.N.P.O.C.' using German translations, please join me in thanking Sirja! Amazing job![/p][/*][/list][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p]Monkeys have invaded the islands. Unlike sealions, they can't be trusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution Scaling. Some people have experienced a blurriness so I added a 'Resolution Scaling' option in the settings menu to combat this issue. The default is 100% but can be increased to up to 200% to make the graphics more crisp at higher resolutions. This setting does greatly impact FPS so try to find a good balance. You can reduce the setting below 100% if you want to gain FPS at the cost of a more pixelated view. I can't test this on every resolution/monitor/graphics card combo, so please let me know if this change helps or not. Also, this setting does not save yet, and will have to be adjusted every time until I update it.[/p][/*][*][p]Raft Covers can now be placed on land as well as on the raft to be used for shade and decoration.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45504978/4671c93a275c103644db2e3e9b70be2641cbff53.png"][/img][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed resources getting stuck on the ground.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed getting stuck in carrying mode when not carrying anything.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed campfires and fireplaces being able to be build on raft.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inconsistent sizes of resource meshes on raft barrels inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced chance of getting a map piece when digging up an X marks the spot when there are plenty more in the world to discover. 25% chance now instead of 50%.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Feedback Update - Minigames / Quick Time Events
notes.notes:
I've heard a lot of feedback indicating the annoyance of the "minigames" or "quick time events" that are used for various things like fishing or unlocking tools. I have added a "Difficulty" setting when creating a new game that allows your to choose an "Easy" mode that disables these events from occurring. Existing games will continue to use the "Hard" mode setting that keeps the quick time events on. 

Thanks for all of the support and keep the feedback coming in.

Localization of menu text and subtitles have been added for Spanish and German. There will be mistakes as I don't speak either of these languages, but I wanted to try to get this update out as quickly as possible.
